summary: BRP Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended April 30, 2026. The filing shows net income of C$128.9M compared to C$150.1M in the prior-year period, with revenues of C$2,391.8M. The report includes standard financial statements, certifications, and an exhibit index. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is announced. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or structural changes to analyze.
